description: This file defines the enum ConnectionLifecycle, representing the lifecycle states of a network connection, specifically ACTIVE and DELETED, along with a static method to retrieve enum instances by name.

classes.name: ConnectionLifecycle
classes.description: An enumeration of a Connection's lifecycle, with values ACTIVE and DELETED, and a static method for lookup by name.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ConnectionLifecycle enum corresponding to the provided name, or empty if no match is found.
